summary: Aperture AC filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its IPO of 10,200,000 units at $10.00/unit, including partial exercise of the over-allotment option, for gross proceeds of $102M. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one right to receive one-fourth of a share upon an initial business combination. The filing describes standard IPO agreements (underwriting, rights, trust, registration). No special-situation event occurred; this is a routine SPAC IPO registration.
